t: The Hard Thing About Hard Things
pitch: The decisions no manual prepares you for: laying people off, fighting to survive, keeping your team, and holding up psychologically.
br: Case study: the agency in crisis
quiz: What transformation did Horowitz lead to save his company?
Selling the hosting business and becoming a software company (Opsware)
He gave up most of his revenue to save what could be saved.
Facing a serious problem, there's no magic fix, only patient work
Looking for a brilliant idea is often a way of avoiding the real problem.
Who should announce a layoff to an employee?
People will remember for the rest of their lives how they were treated.
What does Horowitz think of the compliment sandwich?
People see through it quickly; better to be direct and sincerely caring
Experienced people eventually stop believing the compliments.
When it faces an existential threat
You then have to focus, decide fast and shake up habits.
According to Horowitz, where do politics in an organization come from?
Vague promotion criteria reward those who lobby.
What is a CEO's hardest skill?
Keeping a clear head under constant pressure.
What distinguishes the hero from the coward according to Horowitz?
They feel the same fear; what they do with it differs
Courage means acting despite fear, after listening.
